notes.title: Smoother Multiplayer, Smarter Achievements, Better Ragdolls
notes.content:
[h2]New update is available now!
[/h2][h3]Multiplayer[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed softlock if [b]Player 1 lost all lives & credits[/b] before Player 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed softlock when starting the [b]next Chapter without Player 2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where [b]Mouse & Keyboard[/b] were forced when using [b]two controllers[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]pause menu input[/b] after a Player’s death.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Controls & UI[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed cursor being confined in [b]Windowed Mode[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]mouse selection[/b] in the Secret Lab Locker.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]UI flickering[/b] between controller and Mouse & Keyboard when opening the [b]Windows Game Bar[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]input hints for Player 2[/b] in the Trunk.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]Secret Lab Bestiary input mapping[/b] to prevent conflicts with arrow navigation.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]"Ready, Go" screen[/b] sometimes not appearing in Boss Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]costume saving issue[/b] when changing before Controller Choice screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Rogan’s hair[/b] display on the Game Over map.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]enemy ragdolls[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Collision and graphic [b]improvements for Chapter 2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chapter 2 cutscene[/b] improvements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]End game cutscene dialog[/b] improvements.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Achievements & Collectibles[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]collectible statistics[/b] tracking.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]Gatherer achievement[/b] unlocking and clarified description.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]Partners achievement[/b] to correctly check if both players are alive.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Localization[/h3][list][*][p]Minor [b]translation adjustments[/b].


[b]Thank you for your ongoing feedback![/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Achievements Fixed + Visuals and Gameplay Improvements
notes.content: [p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes[/b][/p][p][b]Achievements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cheat codes no longer block [i]"Gatherer"[/i] and [i]"Do You Really Know How To Use It?"[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Alternative routes no longer prevent unlocking [i]"Traveller"[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Headshot counter for [i]"Headhunter"[/i] now works as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][i]"The Reinforcements Have Arrived!"[/i] now unlocks correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Retroactive Unlocks[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]"Gatherer"[/i] and [i]"Do You Really Know How To Use It?"[/i] — unlock after finishing any level.[/p][/*][*][p][i]"Traveller"[/i] — unlock after completing first path.[/p][/*][*][p][i]"Headhunter"[/i] — unlock after first headshot.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved texture issues in some campaign areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing player movement components.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected missing textures on UFO collectible.[/p][/*][*][p]Closed environment gaps.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored animations for Harry and Amy.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other[/b][/p][list][*][p]Credits updated.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Update - further textures and lighting optimization
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! A new update is now live and ready to download, please read the full patch notes below:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Global Changes:[/b][/p][p]- Correct handling of gamma settings[/p][p]- Eliminated sudden changes in display effects (jumping between post-process zones)[/p][p]- Adjustments to the display of items collected by the player [/p][p][/p][p][b]Training Mode:[/b][/p][p]- Visual improvements to Training 04, 05, 08, and 09[/p][p]Campaign – Chapter 02:[/p][p]- Fixed level loading system[/p][p]- Fixed environment rendering issues[/p][p][/p][p][b]Campaign – Chapter 05:[/b][/p][p]- Improved lighting in the level intro[/p][p]- Improved lighting during the Judgment fight[/p][p]- Adjusted special effect materials during the Magician fight[/p][p][/p][p][b]Campaign – Chapter 06:[/b][/p][p]- Visual improvements: brightened dark locations, fixed textures issues[/p][p]- Fixed environment during the Emperor fight[/p][p]- Fixed rendering issues for dynamic objects before Goldman’s room[/p][p]- Adjustments to the level loading system[/p][p]- Removed the pink flash at the start of the Emperor fight[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game Completion Room:[/b][/p][p]- Fixed rendering issues[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your ongoing feedback and support![/p]

notes.title: Texture Loading, Visual Fixes & More
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! A new update is now live and ready to download! This patch brings a few key improvements based on your feedback: [/p][list][*][p]Smoother texture loading,[/p][/*][*][p]Shader tweaks for better visual stability,[/p][/*][*][p]Restored enemy dissolve effects after death,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed and improved score display in multiplayer mode,[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for playing and sharing your thoughts. We're continuing to work on more fixes and improvements, so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD 2: Remake is a remake of the second entry in the well-known and popular rail-shooter series. Take on the lone role of a secret agent as James or Gary, or team up in co-op mode to neutralize the dangerous undead monsters standing in your way.

[b]Story:[/b]
In February 2000, a small city was suddenly overrun by hostile creatures. Two AMS agents, James Taylor and Gary Stewart, were sent to investigate. Upon arrival, they noticed that the situation resembled the Curien Mansion incident from 1998. Determined to uncover the source of the infestation, they began shooting their way through hordes of creatures.
[b]
Demo includes:[/b]
• First level of the game
• Co-op mode
• Remastered music (with the classic soundtrack also available in the game)
• Modern graphics
• Gameplay faithful to the original game
